verdict.rationale: The evidence shows versioned API clients with major releases: an official 'algolia-migration' skill moves client code to the latest major version across many languages. One community user also reports that the API hasn't changed over time, which suggests stability. Nothing in the pack documents a formal API versioning scheme or a deprecation policy. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy and timelines, explicit REST API versioning scheme, and changelog or sunset notices.
